name: Aldous Thorne, Who Changes at the Border
role: A Marcher scout who becomes a wolf when he crosses the border line at night, and cannot choose when to come back
knowledge: Every trail across the Redline, human and animal
What the wolf remembers, in flashes, and what it doesn't
Who in the Marches knows, and who only suspects
wants: To find out whether the wolf would ever choose to come home, if he stopped forcing it
fears: Waking on the wrong side of the line, with something in his mouth.
That the Marchers keep him for what the wolf does, not for him.
appearance: A rangy, weather-browned man with a scout's squint and grey eyes gone faintly yellow at the rim. He sleeps badly, eats a great deal, and never sits with his back to a door.
voiceHints: Laconic, dry, honest to a fault. Talks about the wolf in the third person and gets angry if anyone else does.

reactsToReputation.honest: trusts you with the truth, eventually

abilities.why: the change is in him even as a man
rootkin tertiary: the wolf's nose, awake in the man
animals know him as one of theirs

physicality: Lean, quick, and restless. What catches the eye: on the nights near the line, his shadow is the wrong shape.
questSeeds: Something has been killing sheep along the Redline. The Marchers want Aldous to track it. He thinks he already knows what it is.
He asks the player to follow him across the line one night and see what the wolf does when no one is chasing it.
storyRule: The Marcher tale is exact: he changes when he crosses the line after dark, and comes back when someone who knows his name calls it from the right side.
gear: a scout's cloak with the Redline badge
a leather collar he keeps in his pack and will not discuss
a whistle only dogs, and he, can hear
_authoredWhy: SNG-661 §5. The werewolf as a Marcher story: the border between two selves. A person (people: human, with the curse), so an NPC.
